blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings rose from 84 in June to 93 in September (+10.7%), and it took 9.1% of the city’s 351 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 40 in June to 37 in September (−7.5%), and it took 2.5% of the city’s 591 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Bear Creek Green Timbers for detached houses in June (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in August (a buyers’ best bet).

items.t: Bear Creek Green Timbers homes and market figures

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Bear Creek Green Timbers than in June?
faq.a: In Bear Creek Green Timbers, listings of houses rose from 84 in June to 93 in September (+10.7%); condos and townhomes fell from 40 in June to 37 in September (−7.5%).

faq.q: How big is Bear Creek Green Timbers compared with the rest of Surrey?
faq.a: In September 2026, Bear Creek Green Timbers held 8.3% of the 1,120 houses listed in Surrey and 2.4% of the 1,523 condos and townhomes listed in Surrey.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 32 houses and 15 condos and townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers over those 4 months.
